title: Unit 4 第四课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 对画线部分提问
sections.instruction: 根据画线部分写出相应的特殊疑问句，选出正确的一项。

questions.translation: 吉姆的生日在7月20日。—— 吉姆的生日是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 对具体日期时间提问用 When，后接系动词 is + 主语 Jim's birthday，故选 When is Jim's birthday。

questions.translation: 我喜欢美术是因为它令人放松。—— 你为什么喜欢美术？
questions.explanation: 对 because 引导的原因状语提问用 Why，主语由 I 变为 you，助动词用 do，动词为 like，故选 Why do you like art。

questions.translation: 我的英语老师是周老师。—— 谁是你的英语老师？
questions.explanation: 对人物 Miss Zhou 提问用疑问代词 Who，第一人称 My 改为第二人称 your，故选 Who is your English teacher。

questions.translation: 我的飞机模型在桌子上。—— 你的飞机模型在哪里？
questions.explanation: 对地点介词短语 on the table 提问用疑问副词 Where，主语是单数，be 动词用 is，故选 Where is your model plane。

questions.translation: 现在是七点半。—— 现在几点了？
questions.explanation: 对时刻 seven thirty 提问用 What time is it now? 或 What's the time now? 故选 What time is it now。

sections.title: II. 选词填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择合适的形容词填空，每个词只能用一次。

questions.prompt: 1. Lucy, can you help me? This book is ______ for me.
questions.translation: 露西，你能帮我一下吗？这本书对我来说太难了。
questions.explanation: 由“can you help me”可知书太难，用形容词 difficult（困难的）。故选 difficult。

questions.prompt: 2. Cindy thinks tennis is ______. She likes it.
questions.translation: 辛迪认为网球很有趣。她很喜欢它。
questions.explanation: 由“She likes it”可知觉得网球有趣，用形容词 interesting（有趣的）。故选 interesting。

questions.prompt: 3. Tina's room is not ______. Her things are everywhere.
questions.translation: 蒂娜的房间不整洁。她的东西到处都是。
questions.explanation: 由“Her things are everywhere”可知房间不整洁，用形容词 tidy（整洁的）。故选 tidy。

questions.prompt: 4. English is ______ for Mike. He does well in every English test.
questions.translation: 英语对迈克来说很简单。他每次英语考试都考得很好。
questions.explanation: 由“He does well in every English test”可知英语对他很容易，用形容词 easy（容易的）。故选 easy。

questions.prompt: 5. I think watching TV is ______. I like to play sports.
questions.translation: 我觉得看电视很无聊。我喜欢做运动。
questions.explanation: 由后半句转折喜欢做运动可知觉得看电视无聊，用形容词 boring（无聊的）。故选 boring。

sections.title: III. 选词填空 (主谓一致与助动词)
sections.instruction: 用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，完成句子。
sections.passage:
1. He [1] (like, likes) bananas, but he [2] (don't, doesn't) like oranges.
2. We [3] (likes, like) hamburgers, but we don't [4] (like, likes) chicken.
3. They [5] (likes, like) pears, but they [6] (don't, doesn't) like strawberries.
4. I like fruit, but I [7] (don't, doesn't) like vegetables.

questions.translation: 他喜欢香蕉，但他不喜欢橙子。
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词用 likes。故选 likes。

questions.translation: 但他不喜欢橙子。
questions.explanation: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定句助动词用 doesn't。故选 doesn't。

questions.translation: 我们喜欢汉堡包，但我们不喜欢鸡肉。
questions.explanation: 主语 We 是第一人称复数，谓语动词用原形 like。故选 like。

questions.translation: 但我们不喜欢鸡肉。
questions.explanation: 助动词 don't 后面接动词原形 like。故选 like。

questions.translation: 他们喜欢梨，但他们不喜欢草莓。
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是第三人称复数，谓语动词用原形 like。故选 like。

questions.translation: 但他们不喜欢草莓。
questions.explanation: 主语 they 是复数，否定句助动词用 don't。故选 don't。

questions.translation: 我喜欢水果，但我讨厌/不喜欢蔬菜。
questions.explanation: 主语 I 是第一人称单数，否定句助动词用 don't。故选 don't。

sections.title: IV. 阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下列书信与邮件，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Hi Ann,
How are you? Do you like your school? I like my school a lot. My teachers are very nice. Some of my subjects are fun, but some of them are boring. I like English and art, but I don't like math.
My brother likes his school, too. He likes math, but he doesn't like English. His favourite class is P.E.. He likes it very much. His favourite teacher is Mrs. Wang. Does your sister like her school? What subject do you like?

Emma

---

Hi Emma,
It's nice to hear from you. I'm fine, thanks. Yes, I like my school, but my sister doesn't. She doesn't like homework! I like music and English, but I don't like P.E.. I like all of my teachers. Miss Lee is my favourite teacher. She teaches music. Her classes are always fun. Do you have a favourite teacher?

Ann

questions.translation: 艾玛不喜欢什么？—— 数学。
questions.explanation: 根据 Emma 的信中“I like English and art, but I don't like math.”可知她不喜欢数学。故选 math。

questions.translation: 艾玛的哥哥/弟弟最喜欢的课程是：体育。
questions.explanation: 根据 Emma 的信中“His favourite class is P.E.. He likes it very much.”可知是他最喜欢的课是体育课。故选 P.E.。

questions.translation: 谁是安最喜欢的老师？—— 李老师（Miss Lee）。
questions.explanation: 根据 Ann 的回信中“Miss Lee is my favourite teacher. She teaches music.”可知是 Miss Lee。故选 Miss Lee。

questions.prompt: 4. Ann mainly writes about ________ in her e-mail.
questions.translation: 安在她的电子邮件中主要写了关于什么？—— 她的学校生活。
questions.explanation: 根据回信内容，安回答了关于喜不喜欢学校、喜爱的学科、喜爱的老师等内容，主要涉及她的学校生活。故选 her school life。

sections.title: V. 趣味挑战
sections.instruction: 挑战英语趣味思维题与脑筋急转弯，写出或选择正确答案。

questions.prompt:
1. There are three teachers: Mr. Li, Mr. Wang and Mr. Zhang. Each of them teaches two of the six subjects: biology, physics, English, P.E., history and math. We know:
a. The physics teacher and P.E. teacher are neighbours.
b. Mr. Li is the youngest of the three.
c. Mr. Zhang, the biology teacher and the P.E. teacher always go home together.
d. The biology teacher is older than the math teacher.
e. On weekends, the English teacher, math teacher and Mr. Li like playing volleyball together.
Who is the English teacher?
questions.translation: 有三位老师：李老师、王老师和张老师。他们每人教六门学科中的两门。谁是英语老师？—— 王老师。
questions.explanation: 由e可知李老师既不教英语也不教数学，且英语老师与数学老师是另外两人（王老师和张老师各教一门）。由c可知张老师不教生物和体育，故生物老师和体育老师是李老师和王老师。由d知生物老师比数学老师年龄大，而b说李老师最年轻，故李老师不能是生物老师，所以王老师教生物。由e知王老师在英语和数学中教一门，但王老师教生物且生物老师比数学老师年龄大（说明生物老师不是数学老师），故王老师教英语，张老师教数学。故选 Mr. Wang。

questions.prompt: 2. From what number can you take half and leave nothing? ______
questions.translation: 从哪个数字中拿走一半会什么都不剩？—— 8（把8横着切开或拿走一半是0）。
questions.explanation: 英语经典脑筋急转弯：数字8上下两半都是0（zero/nothing），拿走一半留下0。故填 8。

questions.prompt: 3. What 5-letter word has 6 left when you take 2 letters away? ______
questions.translation: 哪个由5个字母组成的单词拿走2个字母后还剩6？—— sixty（拿走ty剩下six）。
questions.explanation: sixty（60）是5个字母，拿走最后2个字母 ty 后剩下的单词是 six（6）。故填 sixty。

questions.prompt: 4. I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, rivers but without water. What am I? A ______.
questions.translation: 我有城市但没有房屋，有森林但没有树木，有河流却没有水。我是什么？—— 地图。
questions.explanation: 谜语：地图（map）上有标注城市、森林、河流但没有实体建筑、树木或水。故填 map。

questions.translation: 杨辉三角/帕斯卡金字塔空白处应填入什么数字？—— 6。
questions.explanation: 根据杨辉三角（Pascal's Triangle）规律，每一行的每个数等于上一行相邻两数之和。第4行为 1, 3, 3, 1；第5行为 1, 4, 6, 4, 1（3 + 3 = 6）。故填 6。

questions.prompt:
6. [HTML:
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526
] The alphabet (字母表) and numbers above can help you with the code (密码) question. If G 15 T 19 D is HOUSE, then R 16 N 18 S is ______.
questions.translation: 如果 G 15 T 19 D 代表 HOUSE，那么 R 16 N 18 S 代表的是：SPORT。
questions.explanation: 密码规律：奇数位字母向后推1位字母（G->H, T->U, D->E；R->S, N->O, S->T）；偶数位数字直接对应字母表中第几个字母（15->O, 19->S；16->P, 18->R）。由此解密得 S-P-O-R-T。故填 SPORT。

sections.title: VI. (2025·泸州)完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后在各题所给的四个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Maddie liked everything about her new house except the little smelly pond (水池) in the back garden.

"[1]" she said, holding her nose.

"Yes, the smell is a little strong." Maddie's dad said. "Let's see what we can do about [2]!"

"We can bring the pond back to life." Maddie said.

Bringing a pond back to life was a lot of [3]. They got the water out, dug out the old soil, cleaned the sides and cleared away the dry leaves and plants around the pond.

Then, they placed rocks at the bottom. After that, they bought some plants and goldfish and [4] all these in their pond.

"Hooray, we made it." Maddie shouted.

Now, Maddie liked everything about her new [5], especially the pond in the back garden! It was with hard work that she created a beautiful pond.

questions.translation: “真糟糕/太难闻了，”她捏着鼻子说。
questions.explanation: 捏着鼻子且池塘很臭（smelly pond），表示气味难闻极了，用感叹词 Terrible（糟糕透了）。故选 Terrible。

questions.translation: “让我们看看能为它做些什么吧！”
questions.explanation: 代指单数名词 the smell 或 the pond，用代词 it。故选 it。

questions.translation: 让一个水池起死回生需要做很多繁重的工作。
questions.explanation: 由后文抽出水、挖出泥土、清理四周等一系列辛苦的劳动可知，需要做大量的“工作（work）”。故选 work。

questions.translation: 他们买了一些水生植物和金鱼，并将它们都放入池塘中。
questions.explanation: put... in their pond 意为“把……放入池塘中”。故选 put。

questions.translation: 现在，麦蒂喜欢关于她新家的一切，尤其是后花园的池塘！
questions.explanation: 呼应首句“Maddie liked everything about her new house except...”，此时新家（house）的一切她都喜欢了。故选 house。
